title: McFlurry Gets a 2,000hp Twin Turbo Coyote Swap In ONE WEEK

reason_for_swap.fact: Godzilla engine was injured at FL2K; team had ~3 weeks before World Cup and chose a Coyote swap; also noted they were beaten by a Coyote car at FL2K

build_history.fact: McFlurry versions: V1 Godzilla swap, V2 built Godzilla, V3 = this Coyote swap

timeline.fact: Godzilla pulled about one week before first start of the Coyote

context.target_event: World Cup (Import vs Domestic World Cup implied; caption says 'World Cup')
context.unrelated_segments: Cars & Coffee / helicopter meetup (every third Saturday 8-10am); diesel project fuel bleeding (12 gallons of oil); DraftKings ad; Freedom Factory event plug Nov 17-18

cars.owner_driver: McFarland Racing; fab by Ty, Sam, Zach, Jackstand

engine.family: Ford Coyote (5.0 implied, displacement not stated)
engine.builder: TKM (caption 'tkm'); built in ~10 days as a '2,000 hp worthy' Coyote
engine.block: Darton sleeves (caption 'Dart and sleeves'), custom dry deck with added coolant passages, billet main caps, ARP main studs
engine.head_sealing: Top Fuel hoops (caption) + Flatout copper head gaskets (caption 'Flatout copper gaskets'); ARP head studs
engine.rotating_assembly: Wiseco custom pistons (caption 'wisco'), aluminum rods (caption 'RNR aluminum rods', brand low confidence), bearings brand unclear (caption 'cite bearings'), Total Seal piston rings, ATI balancer
engine.heads: Livernois CNC ported heads (caption 'liver noise'), PAC springs (caption 'pack Springs'), titanium retainers, billet cam caps (+ARP cam cap bolts), custom valves
engine.cam: Comp Cams camshaft/valvetrain; timing components brand garbled (caption 'rgr')
engine.valve_covers: TKM custom billet valve covers (tall; required turbo kit adjustments); no breathers yet at first start
engine.intake: Plazmaman billet intake manifold (caption 'plasma man'), shipped from overseas

mockup_note.fact: Sam's stock Coyote used as mockup engine; said to be an ~800 hp stocker, not suitable for the ~2,000 hp plan

power_adder.description: 'really small' turbos; team doubts they can feed the engine's full potential

boost_psi.note: about 3 psi on a free rev; wastegates opened on revs

power_adder.placement: turbo kept below hood line; upper fender exhaust exit (first in their shop)

exhaust.headers: Flowtech turbo headers from Holley (caption 'flow Tech from Holly'); budget-friendly, fit nearly perfectly; Ty welds on own male/female V-band flanges

fuel.pump: belt-driven mechanical fuel pump via Motion Raceworks drive bracket (pump hangs forward)
fuel.injectors: two sets of injectors (secondary injector rail; Sam fabricated longer injector blanks)

ecu.brand: Haltech (caption 'htech'); plug-and-play Coyote swap harness with jumpers; Holley coils; widebands

converter.notes: new converter matched to Lenco + Coyote

fuel_tank_note.fact: tank holds ~3.75 gal (said 'three and three quarters'); filling 5

failures.cause: loose line at the pump; large fuel leak once pressure built at first crank; pump needs resealing
harness plug issues/crank-cam sensor nearly swapped

milestones.event: first start: idled on its own, turbos made small boost on revs

parts.part: TKM built Coyote long block (full list above)
Motion Raceworks Coyote water-port AN adapters

cars.confidence: high for parts list structure; medium for brand spellings flagged as caption corrections

game_use.build_time: TKM built the engine in ~10 days; swap completed in ~1 week
